'''Halsia Banso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was active during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Banso was among the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who were assigned to the [[Dread Executioners]], fighting the forces of the [[Dread Masters]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]] during the phase of the conflict known as the [[Dread War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Halsia Banso was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as part of Game Update 2.4: The Dread War. She appeared on Oricon, where she was the Basic Gear vendor for the Sith Inquisitor class. Banso and the rest of the class gear vendors at Oricon, along with all other Daily Areas and high-level planets, were replaced by standardized vendors in Game Update 4.0<ref name="TOR" /> on [[October 20]], [[2015]];<ref name="Patch4">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> she was replaced by Lord [[Turbis]].<ref name="TOR" />
